jobs.title: Cin7 Inventory Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Cin7 Inventory Implementation Specialist**

Pay: $70,000\.00 per year

Location: Monroe, NC (Remote) — must reside in North Carolina. Occasional travel required to client locations and to our Monroe, NC office.

**Compensation:** $70,000/year

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Certum Solutions is hiring a full\-time Cin7 Inventory Implementation Specialist** — a hands\-on Cin7 consultant, not a support\-desk role — to lead end\-to\-end Cin7 deployments for our inventory\-heavy clients — configuring multi\-warehouse operations, migrating messy data, and training client teams to run the platform confidently long after we're gone.

**About Certum Solutions**

Certum Solutions is a boutique, U.S.\-based accounting and ERP consulting firm purpose\-built for businesses generating $1M–$30M in revenue. We deliver bookkeeping, accounting software implementation, ERP consulting, and fractional CFO advisory all under one roof. We're platform\-agnostic and vendor\-neutral, holding certifications across QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho, Odoo, Cin7, Katana, and more. We're woman\-owned, BBB\-accredited (A\+), and have served thousands of clients across the country.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a full\-time Cin7 Inventory Implementation Specialist to lead full\-cycle deployments of Cin7's inventory, order\-management, and POS modules for inventory\-heavy clients. The position is fully remote; the only firm location requirement is North Carolina residency, with occasional travel to client locations and to our Monroe, NC office.

**Industries You'll Support**

We work with inventory\-heavy clients across B2B/wholesale, CPG, fashion \& apparel, food \& beverage, electronics, manufacturing \& distribution, automotive, sporting goods, and general merchandise. Tell us which verticals you know best.

**A Day in the Life**

No two days look exactly alike. You might start the morning on a pre\-sales scoping call, walking a prospect through record volumes and integration needs, then move into configuring multi\-warehouse logic for a client mid\-implementation. Midday could bring a data migration cleanup — reconciling two exports that don't agree — followed by a live training session walking a client's ops team through their new Cin7 workflows. You'll wrap up by updating milestones in Monday.com, syncing with the team in Teams, and prepping tomorrow's scoping call.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead full\-cycle Cin7 projects: gather requirements, configure multi\-warehouse logic, set up product hierarchies, and integrate with eCommerce and marketplace platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Amazon) and third\-party logistics/fulfillment tools (ShipStation and similar 3PL/WMS systems)
* Cleanse, map, and migrate product catalogs, BOMs, pricing tiers, and historical transaction data
* Develop custom onboarding curricula, host live virtual workshops, and produce SOP documentation so client teams can manage inventory independently
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with accounting and analytics to ensure clean integration with QuickBooks, Xero, and other accounting systems
* Provide post\-go\-live support: troubleshoot configurations, fine\-tune workflow automations, and advise on inventory forecasting and replenishment best practices
* Run structured pre\-sales scoping calls covering platform fit, record volumes, manufacturing complexity, integrations, and data quality — the same way on every deal
* Track milestones, manage scope changes, and report status to stakeholders using Canopy Practice Management and Microsoft Teams

What We're Looking For

* 3–5 years of hands\-on implementation experience with Cin7 Core, Cin7 Omni, or both (or a comparable inventory/ERP platform such as Katana or Odoo) — you've implemented the platform, not just used it
* Consulting experience: you've owned client relationships, run discovery workshops, written statements of work, and pushed back on scope changes
* A troubleshooter's instinct: you diagnose the root cause in a client's data or workflow rather than just reconfiguring settings around it
* Proven ability to run multiple concurrent implementations at once without dropping a ball
* QuickBooks migration experience — Desktop\-to\-Online migrations, or QuickBooks Online integrated with an inventory platform; you understand what the integration will and won't carry across
* Strong grasp of inventory concepts: SKUs, lot/serial tracking, multi\-warehouse, landed cost, opening stock valuation, demand planning
* Advanced spreadsheet skills: lookups, data cleanup, reconciling two exports that disagree
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to C\-level executives and delivering remote training
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* Must be a legal resident of North Carolina with reliable high\-speed internet and a suitable home\-office setup

**Preferred / Bonus Skills**

* Experience with both Cin7 Core and Cin7 Omni — we implement both product lines
* Experience designing clearing account structures for Cin7\-to\-accounting integrations
* Katana experience alongside Cin7
* Prior Cin7 implementations for high\-volume, multi\-channel retailers
* Manufacturing background: multi\-level BOMs, subcontract and outside processing, work centers, batch traceability
* EDI, 3PL, or middleware integration work;
* Xero alongside QuickBooks
* Certifications in Cin7, or other ERP platforms
* Advanced inventory analytics: ABC classification, safety\-stock calculations, demand forecasting
* Experience with Power BI or Tableau for inventory dashboards
* CPA, CSCP, or similar supply\-chain credential

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Salary: $70,000/year
* Device: Company\-issued laptop plus docking station
* Retirement: 401(k) with 3% employer match
* Health: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance eligibility for full\-time employees
* Time Off: 3 weeks PTO \+ paid holidays
* Professional Development: Continuing education reimbursement (with prior approval) \+ certification opportunities

**Ready to Apply?**

If you're passionate about turning complex inventory challenges into streamlined, data\-driven solutions — and you thrive in a fully remote, collaborative environment — please submit your résumé, a brief cover letter describing a recent Cin7 (or similar) implementation you led, and any relevant certifications through this posting.

Certum Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Benefits: 401(k), 401(k) matching, Dental insurance, Flexible schedule, Health insurance, Paid time off, Professional development assistance, Vision insurance

Job Type: Full\-time

Education: Bachelor's (Preferred)

Location: Monroe, NC (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote

Pay: $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Monroe, NC 28110

jobs.title: Lead Implementation Ops
jobs.description:
Paylocity is an award\-winning provider of cloud\-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest\-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy\-to\-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.


While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.


Help our award\-winning technology company run effectively as you take on big challenges and find solutions with a position in Operations.


Use your problem\-solving skills to shape the way others see Paylocity. Launch your career with us!

**In\-Office:** This is a 100% in\-office role based at our **Schaumburg, IL** location. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days per week during designated work hours.

**This Lead Implementation Ops role will be responsible for providing coverage and support primarily for the MST/PST time zones.**

**Position Overview**


The Implementation Team Lead will provide coaching, mentoring and leadership to Implementation Consultants. The Team Lead will collaborate with the Consultants, to identify areas of success and provide feedback and coaching around areas of improvement, as well as offer praise and positive promotion of a job well done. The Team Lead will be instrumental in assisting the Implementation Managers, by providing regular updates around staff performance, client issues, actions to be taken to improve department, drive quality metrics and maintain implementation success. The Team Lead must be able to identify and effectively communicate gaps in training, performance deficit trends, and offer improvement solutions. They will ensure all critical aspects of implementation issues are met and resolved appropriately and be willing to respond to new client issues in a prompt, accurate and courteous manner.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Supervise operations for their designated team
* Supervise the work of their assigned group on a day\-to\-day basis, which may include delegation of work assignments to various team members
* Provide support, coaching and development of new and existing team members
* Facilitate communication and expectations through regularly occurring meetings, 1:1s or team huddles
* Provide input and recommendations to managers in the areas of performance management, promotional opportunities, employee terminations and performance issues. Manager will collaborate with TL and define next steps/action.
* Develop and collaborate with management on best practices and ways to improve the team’s performance
* Troubleshoot escalated client/departmental issues and offer client solutions that align to both satisfaction and organizational direction (tiered approach)
* Accountability to meet defined KPIs
* Act as primary contact for new hires and partner with ISA Team and L\&D to make recommendations for supplemental training for all team members
* Use functional and technical knowledge to assist team members
* Assist in answering client overflow calls
* Mentor/coach peers as needed

**Behaviors and Skills**

* Mentor/coach peers to success by providing timely coaching, feedback, and training that results in improved performance
* Organization – We work in a matrix environment meaning that you will be working with more than one consultant in different project phases (i.e., start up, configuration, production).
* Expert project management skills, the ability to manage multiple projects and effectively prioritize, while delivering within deadlines is essential
* Excellent communication skills \- understands and can adapt to the differences in communication styles to influence and drive results
* Research and troubleshoot complex problems, combined with the ability to cultivate compassion, and effectively de\-escalate client conflict, for a mutually beneficial solution
* Leverage data, available insights, and analytics to drive performance \& decision making
* Collaborate in a team environment \- can lead client/team meetings, while promoting inclusion and diversity
* Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to manage change successfully, and pivot when necessary

**Education and Experience**

* Minimum two years’ experience in an Implementation role required
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Must have a complete understanding of Paylocity’s implementation standards, policies, and procedures
* Proficiency in MS office

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously.

**Paylocity is an equal\-opportunity employer.** Paylocity is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. At Paylocity, we believe diversity makes us better.


We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, culture, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion or spiritual belief, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We actively cultivate these differences through our employee resource groups (ERGs), employee experiences, perspectives, talents, and approaches to drive innovation in the software and services we provide our customers.


We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request reasonable accommodation in the job application or interview process, please contact accessibility@paylocity.com. This email address is exclusively designated for such requests, aligning with federal and state disability laws. Please do not send resumes to this email address, as they will be removed.


The pay range for this position is $57,200 \- $80,000/yr; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and restricted stock unit grant based on individual performance in addition to a full range of benefits . This information is provided per the relevant state and local pay transparency laws for the location in which this position will be performed. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via www.paylocity.com/careers.

Maintain a high\-level of organization and attention to detail through the implementation process to meet client deadlines and achieve successful outcomes.

jobs.title: Court Reporting Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Remote Legal**  

At Remote Legal, our 40\-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash\-in\-the\-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time\-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client\-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward\-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone. **About the role**  

The Reporter Training Specialist\- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high\-quality services. Works cross\-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

 **What you'll do*** Sources court reporters through approved recruiting platforms, including Rippling
* Conducts interviews, evaluates qualifications, and supports hiring decisions for reporters
* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information
* Recruits, onboards, trains, and oversees direct reports as assigned; provides coaching, guidance, and development
* Sets team priorities, allocates workload, and ensures coverage for onboarding, training delivery, and quality reviews
* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed
* Establishes repeatable team workflows, documentation standards, and knowledge\-sharing routines to support consistent delivery and coverage
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications*** Strong training, facilitation, and instructional design skills
* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with multiple departments

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2\-5 years of professional experience, including:


o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles
o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments **W****ork Environment*** This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company\-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high\-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home\-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
* Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds
* Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
* Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.
